name: Helmholtz Blablador
description: Helmholtz's self-hosted open-model service for German research communities.
overview: Blablador is the Helmholtz association's hosted LLM service for research. It runs open Qwen, DeepSeek and GPT-OSS models on institutional hardware, so no commercial provider sees the request. No service-specific public policy resolves payload retention or operator access, so privacy is classified partial.
free_access: Free for Helmholtz and partner researchers
Self-hosted, never routed to commercial vendors
notes: Retention and operator-access rules are set by institutional policy, not a public DPA.
